brief:
Palestinian activists face terrorism charges following a demonstration at Donald Trump's golf resort in Ayrshire, Scotland, according to Al Jazeera English. Protesters targeted the facility with red paint and displayed slogans reading "Gaza is not 4 sale" during the action against the property.

The charges represent a significant legal escalation tied to protest activity related to the Gaza conflict. Police and prosecutors classified the incident under terrorism statutes rather than pursuing standard property damage charges, a decision that underscores heightened tensions surrounding demonstrations connected to Middle Eastern geopolitics on British soil.
dek: Protesters targeted Trump’s Ayrshire resort with red paint and slogans saying 'Gaza is not 4 sale'.
title: Palestinian activists charged with terrorism over Trump resort protest
